Messages.Author: The Fanboy
Messages.Body:
> If Tremere get their slaves as Minio cards, or rather crypt cards, why
> shouldn't Tzi get their slaves as crypt cards too? (the fact that
> ghouls have trouble making other ghouls is one point to make, but
> still...).

Umm...what?

The Giovanni are the zombie-makers (well, the Giovanni, the Nagaraja,
the Harbingers, and the Samedi to a lesser extent) -- and they're
zombies, not vampires. To make a zombie, you must first have a
corpse.

Under Revised rules, vampires leave no corpse when they die -- they
dust (the Buffy effect) immediately.

Or did you mean why don't the Tzim get their ghouls as crypt cards.
The answer? Because they're ghouls, not vampires.

The only vampires that were created as slaves to another were the
Gargoyles.

The Fanboy

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2

>Anyhow... But really though. In the WoD game, can't ghouls gain
>similar powers to vampires? I know that zombies usually have Pot, or
>one disc. of the clan that the vampire who 'sired' him was from.
>Aren't ghouls similar?

I think you mean ghouls again. Zombies are pretty much mindless corpses that
are used as servants or for lowly tasks.

Ghouls can indeed learn some disciplines (as Roger pointed out we have the
Ghouled Street Thug and the Rafastio Ghoul). But just about every ghoul is
still considered to be inferior to even the weakest vampire. Ghouls aren't even
remotely close to a vampire in power (with very few rare exceptions).

Halcyan 2
